connectors.descZh:
一句话，文章自动排好。
理解内容 → 匹配风格 → 推荐模板 → 自动配图排版。
不用学排版，也不用在多个工具之间来回切换。
connectors.descEn: Understands your content → matches the style → recommends a template → auto-illustrates and lays out the article — no layout skills needed, no switching between tools.
examples: 把这篇文章用 135 AI 排版，风格正式简洁，适合政务公众号
帮我把这篇活动推文排得更有设计感，并推荐合适的模板

examples: 帮我找一份八年级上册语文《背影》的课件
搜一下《岳阳楼记》的练习题，要 Word 版
把搜索结果里的第 3 个资源下载到工作区

connectors.descZh: 把 AI 做好的日报、周报、行业动态、演示稿、邀请函发成微信链接和小程序卡片，分享到微信群和朋友圈；每天定时推送到微信，同一链接持续更新，看得到谁看了，邀请函能收报名。
connectors.descEn: LivePage turns what your AI makes (daily briefs, weekly reports, industry news, decks, invitations) into a WeChat link and a mini-program card you can share to WeChat groups and Moments. Push a new edition to your WeChat on a schedule at the same link, see who read it, and collect sign-ups on an invitation.
examples: 根据你对我和我工作的了解，每天早上 8 点帮我整理一份我需要关注的行业动态，用活页推送到我微信
每天收盘后帮我整理一份 A 股复盘，用活页更新同一个链接并推送到我微信
帮我写一份本周工作报告，用活页发成微信链接给同事，明天告诉我谁看了

connectors.descZh: 通过微信、企业微信、小红书、抖音等3Chat中已连接渠道查询、筛选、运营客户。向单个或批量客户定向发送个性化消息。客户产生回复后，已配置的 3Chat Agent 可接续上下文，提供 7×24 小时自主接待，持续完成需求沟通、产品答疑、异议处理和购买引导，帮助商家将客户洞察转化为真实触达和成交机会。
connectors.descEn: Query, filter and manage customers through connected channels in 3Chat such as WeChat, WeCom, RedNote and Douyin, and send personalized messages to individual or bulk targeted customers. After customers reply, the configured 3Chat Agent can follow up on the context, provide 7×24-hour autonomous reception, and continuously complete demand communication, product Q&A, objection handling and purchase guidance, helping merchants turn customer insights into real reach and transaction opportunities.
examples: 我昨天有哪些新客户？
给林女士拟一条跟进消息。
把这张活动图片和介绍，发给张先生。

connectors.descZh: 覆盖全国 311 城（含 33 个县级市）的社保、公积金缴费基数与比例，可查经办截止日、最低工资、社平工资与产假天数；检索社保政策原文与政策分析报告，附原文链接。
connectors.descEn: Social-insurance and housing-fund contribution bases, ratios, filing deadlines and policy sources across 311 Chinese cities; search original policy texts and analysis reports with supporting links.
examples: 北京2026年五险一金缴费基数上下限是多少？
深圳非深户医疗二档的公司和个人缴费比例是多少？
上海社保每月最晚什么时候办理？

生成一张 16:9 的科技发布会主视觉，先说明预计积分消耗
读取我的海报工作流，保留原有节点结构并创建一个春日版本

Subject to organizational configuration and user permissions, query and analyze data, validate business information, take approval actions, and enter business data.

connectors.descZh: 通过自然语言管理铱云供应链：支持订单全链路操作，以及客户、商品、仓库库存、员工组织、资金账户、数据导出、经营统计和预警明细的查询分析。
connectors.descEn: Manage 77ircloud AI Supply Chain using natural language: supports full-lifecycle order operations, as well as query and analysis for customers, products, warehouse inventory, employee organization, financial accounts, data export, business statistics, and warning details.
examples: 分析这个月的订单趋势和业绩情况
帮我把这周已付款的待审核订单全部通过
查看深圳某连锁客户这周的订单记录，根据最近一个订单新开单

connectors.descZh: 审批域聚合连接器：专区接入开通（开白 / 堡垒机 / 公网白名单 / AK-SK / 镜像推送，含写操作、两段式确认）+ 工单取证（只读）；工具名与工具面以运行时为准。
connectors.descEn: Aggregated approval-domain connector: zone onboarding (account whitelisting, bastion hosts, public whitelists, AK/SK, image publishing; submission open, every write needs a two-phase confirmation) plus ticket forensics (enum maps, ticket list, single-ticket detail; read-only). Connects as a remote HTTPS service behind a gateway. Tool names and the current tool face come from the runtime (`tools/list`).
examples: 帮客户开通自驾三区白名单
上次那个申请审批到哪了
申请一个跳板机账号

connectors.descZh: 智驾沙箱连接器：专区落地（开白、堡垒机、公网白名单、镜像推送）、训练排障（逐 Pod 取证）、数据挖掘（作业任务、采集计划、多模态检索）与工单审批；写操作两段式确认 + 幂等。
connectors.descEn: The single ADC sandbox connector, built around three job-to-be-done: landing a zone (whitelisting, bastion accounts, public ingress, image push), locating why a training job failed (Pod-by-Pod events and logs, host and TKE evidence), and mining collected and labeled data (job templates and tasks, collect plans, multimodal retrieval), plus approval workflows and ticket forensics. Every write needs a two-phase confirmation and an idempotency key; upstreams that are not configured are not registered.
examples: 客户要落地自驾专区：先按三层核一遍还缺什么，再把开白、堡垒机、公网白名单和镜像推送权限一起提上去。
这个训练任务卡在容器启动阶段，逐 Pod 看事件和日志，判断是镜像、配额还是数据挂载的问题。
把上周采集计划里的标注数据跑一遍挖掘，先看结果总览，再用多模态检索把命中的样本拉出来。

connectors.nameZh: AE互联·全网工具,一站搞定
connectors.descZh: 1400+ 工具一站调用：AI 生图生视频、电商选品分析、社媒内容与舆情、股票金融数据，注册一次全打通，价格相对官方大幅折扣。目前已覆盖：金融： 查询 A股、美股股票行情、股价、K线、成交量、公司财务、财报及基本面数据，覆盖基金、ETF、外汇、汇率、比特币和加密货币，辅助股票与公司研究、投资分析和市场跟踪。接入 Tushare、CoinGecko 等金融数据服务。内容生成： 支持 AI 生图、文生图、图生图、商品图、海报、抠图、文字渲染、图生视频、文生视频、数字人口播、配音、背景音乐与音效生成。聚合字节跳动即梦相关模型 Dreamina 即梦、Seedream、Seedance，以及可灵 Kling、通义千问 Qwen、通义万相 Wan、腾讯混元 Hunyuan、MiniMax／海螺 AI、智谱 GLM、Google Gemini／Nano Banana／Veo、OpenAI GPT Image／Whisper、Stable Diffusion、FLUX、HeyGen、ElevenLabs 等模型与工具，满足图片制作、视频创作和音频处理需求。信息检索： 按关键词开展联网搜索、新闻查询、行业调研和深度研究，获取 SEO 数据、语义搜索结果、网页内容提取与爬取代理服务。接入 Perplexity、Tavily、Exa、Firecrawl、Linkup 等；支持论文、学术文献、引用关系与专利信息检索，X（Twitter／推特）、YouTube、TikTok 社媒内容与数据查询，以及 GitHub 仓库、代码和开发文档查询。电商： 获取抖音、TikTok Shop、淘宝、天猫、京东、小红书、咸鱼、1688、亚马逊、Shopee、Temu 等平台相关数据，通过蝉妈妈、Kalodata、Sorftime 等服务查询商品、店铺、达人、直播及带货表现，辅助国内与跨境选品、供应商查找、市场调研和竞品分析。其他： 提供高德地图 Amap、和风天气 QWeather 等地图与天气服务，支持地点查询、地理编码、全球及本地天气查询，辅助出行规划；支持 OCR 图片文字识别、文档解析、PDF／Word／Excel／PPT 内容提取，并提供影视、招聘、法律、企业招标投标招投标 等查询 (AgentEarth)。
connectors.descEn: 1400+ Tools, One-Stop Access: AI image & video generation, e-commerce product selection analytics, social media content & sentiment, and stock/financial data — one registration unlocks everything, at prices significantly discounted from official channels. Currently covered:Finance: Access market quotes, stock prices, candlestick charts, trading volumes, corporate financial data, financial reports, and fundamentals for Chinese A-shares and U.S. stocks. Coverage also includes mutual funds, ETFs, foreign exchange, exchange rates, Bitcoin, and other cryptocurrencies, supporting equity and company research, investment analysis, and market monitoring. Integrated financial data providers include Tushare and CoinGecko.Content Generation: Create AI-generated images, generate images from text or reference images, produce product visuals and posters, remove backgrounds, and render text in images. Capabilities also include image-to-video and text-to-video generation, digital avatar presenter videos, voiceovers, background music, and sound effects. The platform brings together ByteDance’s Dreamina (Jimeng), Seedream, and Seedance, alongside Kling, Qwen, Wan, Tencent Hunyuan, MiniMax / Hailuo AI, Zhipu GLM, Google Gemini / Nano Banana / Veo, OpenAI GPT Image / Whisper, Stable Diffusion, FLUX, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, and other models and tools for image production, video creation, and audio processing.Information Retrieval: Run keyword-based web searches, look up news, conduct industry research and in-depth investigations, and access SEO data, semantic search results, web content extraction, and scraping proxy services. Integrated providers include Perplexity, Tavily, Exa, Firecrawl, and Linkup. The platform also supports searches for research papers, academic literature, citation relationships, and patent information; social media content and data queries for X (Twitter), YouTube, and TikTok; and searches for GitHub repositories, code, and developer documentation.E-commerce: Access data related to Douyin, TikTok Shop, Taobao, Tmall, JD.com, Xiaohongshu (RED), Xianyu (Goofish), 1688, Amazon, Shopee, Temu, and other platforms. Services such as Chanmama, Kalodata, and Sorftime provide insights into products, stores, creators, livestreams, and sales performance, supporting product sourcing and selection for domestic and cross-border markets, supplier discovery, market research, and competitor analysis.Other Services: Access mapping and weather services such as Amap and QWeather, with support for place searches, geocoding, and global and local weather queries to assist with travel planning. Additional capabilities include optical character recognition (OCR), document parsing, content extraction from PDF, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files, and searches for film, television, and job-related information(AgentEarth).
examples: 使用 AE 查询特斯拉最新股价、评级共识和目标价
使用 AE 检索 新能源行业的论文、新闻和报告，整理可信结论
使用 AE 查询化妆品品类的达人带货数据、关键词热度和竞品趋势

connectors.descEn: China Lux3D MCP: generate 3D/image assets, check pricing and retrieve task results.

examples: 先联网搜一组宋代美学参考（服饰纹样、青绿山水、木构建筑），据此生成一张汉服少女主视觉概念图；再把这张图做成 12 秒电影感运镜视频：0-4s 缓慢推进特写衣纹、4-8s 环绕微距工艺、8-12s 横移拉远见全景，带氛围光与影视级色调，画面流畅稳定、面部五官清晰不变形、无抖动无闪烁。

搜一下今年新茶饮夏季营销主视觉趋势，据此做一张门店开业促销海报：主标题大字『买一送一』、暖橙色调、左侧 40% 留白、电影感侧光、3:4 竖版，适合朋友圈与小红书投放；另出一张极简冷调备选。

connectors.descEn: QCC Legal is a Chinese legal-data connector for searching, researching, and verifying statutes and judicial cases. On the regulation side it covers the full body of in-force Chinese law — laws, administrative regulations, departmental rules, judicial interpretations, and local regulations — at both the whole-regulation and individual-article level, returning verbatim text tagged with validity status (in force / amended / repealed), legal hierarchy, and promulgating authority, with common-name normalization (e.g. the Civil Code, the Personal Information Protection Law). On the case side it covers a massive corpus of ordinary judgment documents plus 25,000+ authoritative cases — Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate guiding cases, gazette cases, typical cases, and reference cases — filterable by cause of action, court, instance, judgment date, and party. It further verifies legal citations: given any text it detects every statute and case-number reference, checks each against the database, flags validity status, returns the authoritative source and verbatim text, and generates traceable hyperlinks — eliminating fabricated statutes and case numbers in AI-generated legal content. Use natural language to find statutory grounds, run legal research and analysis, retrieve similar cases, pull verbatim originals, and verify citations before delivery.

connectors.descZh: 一站式文档智能处理平台，基于曙光超算互联网国产算力底座，提供三大核心能力：(1) 高精度OCR文字识别与信息提取——支持印刷体/手写文字、印章、表格识别，覆盖财务票据、个人证照、行业资质、金融单据等多场景结构化字段抽取；(2) 高精度文档解析——自研模型驱动，还原整页版式，从目录、段落、表格到公式、化学分子式、图片、印章，拆解为带层级的结构化Markdown数据；(3) 文档格式转换——支持PDF转Word、图片转Word、图片转PPT等多类型互转，高保真还原排版。适用于科研、金融、政务、法律、制造等行业。
connectors.descEn: An all-in-one document intelligence platform powered by Sugon Supercomputing's domestic infrastructure with three core capabilities: (1) High-precision OCR & data extraction — printed/handwritten text, seals, tables, and structured field extraction from invoices, IDs, qualifications, and financial documents; (2) High-fidelity document parsing — reconstructs full-page layouts (TOC, paragraphs, tables, formulas, chemical structures, images, seals) into hierarchical structured Markdown; (3) Document format conversion — PDF-to-Word, image-to-Word, image-to-PPT with high-fidelity layout preservation. Ideal for research, finance, government, legal, and manufacturing.
examples: 识别图片中的文字信息
帮我识别这张增值税发票中的信息
帮我把这份学术论文PDF解析成结构化数据
